verdict.rationale: Scoped API credentials are a fair axis for a hosted search API, so the story applies. The evidence pack only shows that requests carry an `x-algolia-api-key` header and that the CLI signs in through the browser. Nothing documents creating restricted, ACL-scoped, index-limited or otherwise least-privilege keys for an agent.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
